blurb: Golden River Sports is a fly fishing and paddling shop in downtown Golden, Colorado, offering kayak, SUP, tubing, and fly fishing rentals, as well as guided fishing trips. They provide equipment, demos, and coordinate with external providers for lessons. They are located near Clear Creek Whitewater ‘Playpark’ and the ‘Golden Mile’ fishing habitat. Staff are experienced water sports enthusiasts who can help guests with gear and local knowledge.
